description: Territoire à Risque Inondation (TRI) de la baie de l’Aiguillon - Enjeux liés à des activités économiques is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by finess.sante.gouv.fr. Geographical data set produced by the GIS Flooding Directive of the territory at significant risk of flooding (TRI) for the marine submersion of the Baie de l’Aiguillon and mapped for reporting purposes for the European Floods Directive. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Flood Risk Territory (RTI) of Aiguillon Bay - Issues related to economic activities" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include cartographie, Géologie, risque, RISQUE/N_INONDATION, directive inondation, Sols. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
